remarks: TO BE BUILT on 2.18 acres in the Williamsville School District by Brownstone Homes. The rendering shown represents one custom design option, while the home, floor plan, exterior, site layout, and features can be completely customized with the Brownstone Homes design team. Base pricing includes approximately 6,400 square feet of finished living space with 2,500 square feet on the first floor, 2,700 square feet on the second floor, and 1,200 square feet of finished lower level living space. The proposed plan features 4 bedrooms upstairs, including a spacious primary suite, a second bedroom with its own private bath, and two additional bedrooms connected by a shared bath. The first floor includes expansive custom living areas and a half bath, while the finished lower level includes a large recreation room and an additional half bath. Brownstone finishes include Andersen windows, engineered white oak flooring, custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, premium appliances, detailed trim work, tiled showers, heated primary bath flooring, and other custom selections throughout. Build this home, modify it to fit your vision, or start from scratch and create virtually any home you can imagine. The 2.18 acre property provides the opportunity to design the home, driveway, outdoor living areas, pool, landscaping, and yard around your lifestyle. Rendering is conceptual and shown for design inspiration. Property is also offered separately as vacant land for $550,000 under MLS #B1716292 . Price includes complete removal of current structures on lot. Taxes to be determined by town after home completion.
